## Keep the claim as precise as the evidence {#l3-recap }

- A grouped table identifies a **median class**, not every individual value.
- An observed relative frequency provides an **estimate** of probability.
- A prediction for future trials is an **expected count**, not a guarantee.
- More data help when the conditions and sampling method are appropriate.


::: {.takeaway}
Say what you know, what you estimate, and what the data cannot establish.
:::

::: notes
Invite one example of each distinction. Avoid suggesting that a bigger biased sample automatically provides a good estimate.
:::
